subject: Phase-separated translation hubs dock onto mitochondria to extend lifespan
script: From Agewell Brief: Phase-separated translation hubs dock onto mitochondria to extend lifespan. In C. elegans, LARP-1 forms liquid droplets that synthesize key mitochondrial proteins on-site. Keeping these droplets attached during aging preserves cristae and ATP, boosting longevity. LARP-1 droplets (MATOs) dock to mitochondria via TOM complex. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
